scoring_rule.1: Gather or identify the receipts belonging to the month and keep that month's set identifiable so relevant expenses are not lost or mixed with another period.

rius.rationale: Without retaining the relevant month's evidence the later review lacks its intended source material.

scoring_rule.1: Organize the receipts consistently by a useful key such as date, expense category or transaction reference.

rius.rationale: Makes review efficient without mandating both chronological and category sorting.

rius.description: Store the receipts in a readable, retrievable physical or digital location so dates, amounts and expense details remain available for later review.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Store the receipts in a readable, retrievable physical or digital location so dates, amounts and expense details remain available for later review.

rius.rationale: Supplies warning evidence without requiring every vendor-risk metric.

rius.description: Identify and assess at least one feasible alternative or fallback for the critical deliverable, including its readiness or lead-time limits.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Identify and assess at least one feasible alternative or fallback for the critical deliverable, including its readiness or lead-time limits.

rius.rationale: A contingency with no workable fallback leaves the single critical dependency unaddressed; no existing second vendor is assumed.

rius.rationale: Without an activation rule a nominal alternative may not be used before its feasible window closes.

scoring_rule.1: Plan recovery after disruption or fallback activation by verifying the deliverable and restoring or replanning affected downstream work and remaining commitments.
